# Harshan Rasu — Full Stack Developer & AI Automation Specialist

> Founder at Phanix Tech | AI Workflows | High-Performance Web Architectures

## Profile Summary
Harshan Rasu is a Full Stack Developer and AI Automation Specialist based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. He specializes in building client-ready web platforms (MySQL, REST APIs, JSON APIs, Node/Python) and animation-rich, 3D WebGL front-ends (GSAP, Three.js, Lenis). He is the founder of **Phanix Tech**, a digital agency delivering full-stack engineering and AI workflow automation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Full Stack Web Development**: MySQL database architecture, RESTful API design, JSON data pipelines, authentication, and admin dashboards.
- **Interactive & 3D Front-Ends**: GSAP ScrollTrigger timelines, Lenis inertia scrolling, WebGL / Three.js particle canvas engines, and responsive UI/UX.
- **AI & Modern Developer Tools**: Google Antigravity, Claude (Anthropic), Cursor, Lovable, FlutterFlow, Replit Agent, OpenAI API, n8n, Figma, and Git/GitHub.
- **AI Workflow Engineering**: OpenAI API integration, custom prompt engineering, n8n automated pipelines, and Python machine learning.
- **Business Platform Engineering**: Food ordering (TFC Chicken Alrabea), bakery ordering (Seb's Pastry), fitness platforms (Iron Forge Gym), and institutional web redesigns (SNS College of Engineering).

## Education & Academic Background
